subject: What we mean by Foundations.
body:
(NAME), every RU/NED Membership starts in the same place.

Foundations.

Four calls. One month.

Foundations isn’t something you complete before Membership begins. It is where your Membership begins.

We built it to give every person who walks into RU/NED the same starting point before moving into the ongoing rhythm of Membership and Circles.

Some of the work will happen together during our calls. Some of it will happen through your RU/NED profile between them.

What we ask from you is pretty simple:

Show up. Participate. Be honest. Be willing to do the work.

You don’t need to have the right answers. You don’t need to have the hardest story in the room. And you don’t need to know exactly what you want to change before you get here.

You just need to be willing to look at your life honestly and participate in what comes next.

FOUNDATIONS 01
Thursday, November 5
3:00–4:30 PM MT

We’ll make sure you have everything you need before we begin.

Tyler, Libby, Cade & Mitch
RU/NED
After the fear.

subject: One week.
body:
(NAME), one week from today, we start.

FOUNDATIONS 01
Thursday, November 5
3:00–4:30 PM MT

There’s nothing you need to study before you get here.

But there is something worth thinking about:

What do you want to be different because you decided to do this?

Maybe you already know.

Maybe you’re rebuilding something. Starting something. Letting go of something. Maybe life is good and you know there’s still more you want from yourself. Maybe you’re somewhere in the middle and haven’t quite figured out what comes next.

You don’t need a dramatic reason to be here.

Everyone has been RU/NED by something. Usually more than once. And nobody else gets to decide whether your version of hard was hard enough to matter.

We’re not asking you to arrive with everything figured out.

We’re asking you to arrive willing.

We’ll start there.

One week.

We’ll see you November 5 at 3:00 PM MT.

Tyler, Libby, Cade & Mitch
RU/NED
After the fear.
